rules: a rule from a start on no clock in particular (its weeks begin on Monday); the occurrences are the first COUNT the rule has within two hundred years of the start, as an expander written to RFC 5545 section 3.3.10 gives them; where complete is false the rule has fewer than COUNT in two hundred years and an implementation gives these first
examples: the examples of RFC 5545 section 3.8.5.3 as the standard lists them; the start is on the clock of the zone, and an UNTIL written at UTC is read on that clock; where complete is false the standard elides and an implementation gives these first
